product_overview: DuduFisio-AI is an integrated management system designed specifically for physiotherapy clinics that combines traditional clinical management with AI assistance to optimize care delivery, clinical documentation, and operational management.
core_goals: Digitize and automate physiotherapy clinical processes
Enhance the quality of clinical documentation through AI
Increase operational efficiency and patient satisfaction
Provide a comprehensive platform for patient management, scheduling, and exercise prescription
Enable insightful analytics and professional reporting
key_features: Comprehensive patient management with medical history, interactive body map, and secure photo storage
Robust appointment scheduling with calendar views, conflict prevention, recurring appointments, and notifications
Rich clinical documentation supporting SOAP notes, customizable templates, version history, and AI-generated reports
AI Assistant for generating physiotherapy reports, treatment protocols, risk analysis, clinical queries, and economic insights
Exercise library categorized by specialties with multimedia, personalized prescription, contraindication alerts, and difficulty levels
Patient portal offering secure login, access to exercises, appointment management, and communication with the clinic
Dashboard with KPIs, financial and clinical analytics, interactive reports, and PDF export
Financial management including payments, revenue tracking, delinquency management, and multiple payment methods
Inventory control with alerts and historical tracking
Task management system with prioritization, progress tracking and notifications
user_flow_summary: Users authenticate securely via Supabase Auth and are authorized based on role
Administrators manage users, financials, inventory, and task assignments
Physiotherapists access patient profiles, review medical history, and document SOAP notes using rich editor with AI support
Physiotherapists prescribe exercises from the library specifying parameters for patients
Sessions are timed automatically and progress photos can be uploaded and managed within patient evolution records
Appointment scheduling with calendar interface prevents conflicts and supports notifications and rescheduling
Templates allow reuse of common treatment plans and exercise sets
Patient users log into portal to view prescriptions, history, schedule appointments, and communicate with clinic staff
Reports and dashboards provide insights into clinical, operational, and financial data with export options
validation_criteria: System supports 100 concurrent users with page load times under 2 seconds
Accurate role-based access control and session management with timeout
Effective prevention of appointment scheduling conflicts, including recurring appointments
Reliable auto-save, version control, and template management for clinical notes
Successful integration with Google Gemini AI for report generation and clinical queries with fallback mechanisms
Secure upload and deletion of progress photos with proper storage management
Exercise prescription matches specified parameters and contraindication alerts are triggered
Notifications for appointments and task reminders are sent and received reliably
Exported reports in PDF format include all relevant data and maintain formatting quality
Full compliance with LGPD including encryption, audit logs, and user data protection
